Examples: The contract for difference guarantees a price for fifteen years. | Nine projects won a contract for difference in that round.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được; carry out/an + energy audit
Examples: The energy audit found nine easy savings. | An energy audit costs less than one winter of waste.

Definition: chuyên viên đánh giá hiệu quả năng lượng
Pattern: danh từ đếm được; an + energy assessor + inspects
Examples: The energy assessor spent forty minutes in the house. | Energy assessors rate the building, not the household.

Pattern: danh từ đếm được, thường số ít; demand + a just transition
Examples: A just transition means retraining before closure. | Nobody planned a just transition for the coalfields.

Pattern: switch to + N; switch + N
Examples: They switched supplier twice in one year. | She switched to a fixed tariff in time.

Pattern: reinforce + N; thường bị động
Examples: The local network was reinforced last summer. | They reinforced the cable before the heat pumps went in.

Pattern: waste + N; thường bị động
Examples: Nine tenths of the heat is wasted in that boiler. | They waste nothing and still pay too much.

Pattern: heat + N; thường bị động
Examples: The flat is heated by two old convectors. | They heat one room and close the rest.

Pattern: power + N; thường bị động
Examples: The pump is powered by a single panel. | Nine hundred homes are powered from that ridge.

Definition: cấp nhiên liệu cho; thúc đẩy
Pattern: fuel + N; thường bị động
Examples: The boiler is fuelled by wood chip. | Cheap gas fuelled the whole expansion.

Pattern: vent + N; thường bị động
Examples: The gas is vented through the roof. | Heat was vented straight into the yard.

Pattern: escape; escape from + N
Examples: Gas escaped from a joint under the pavement. | Heat escapes at every junction in that system.

Pattern: harness + N; thường bị động
Examples: The river was harnessed in 1904. | They harness the tide twice a day.

Pattern: a fossil-fuelled + N (plant, economy)
Examples: Two fossil-fuelled plants remain on standby. | A fossil-fuelled economy cannot be rebuilt in a decade.

Pattern: a nuclear-powered + N (station, vessel)
Examples: A nuclear-powered station supplies the baseload. | Nuclear-powered vessels refuel once a decade.

Pattern: a solar-powered + N (pump, light)
Examples: Solar-powered lights were installed along the path. | A solar-powered pump waters nine fields.

Pattern: a mains-powered + N (device, alarm)
Examples: Mains-powered alarms are wired into the lighting circuit. | The device is mains-powered with a battery backup.

Pattern: a battery-powered + N (tool, lamp)
Examples: Battery-powered tools replaced the whole generator. | A battery-powered lamp lasted the entire power cut.

Pattern: an airtight + N (building, seal)
Examples: An airtight building needs mechanical ventilation. | The seal is airtight and the frame is not.

Pattern: an energy-hungry + N (process, building)
Examples: The data hall is the most energy-hungry building in the city. | Energy-hungry processes moved to where power was cheap.

Pattern: weather-dependent + N (generation, output)
Examples: Weather-dependent generation needs storage or interconnection. | Weather-dependent output is predictable in aggregate.

Pattern: wasteful + N (practice, design)
Examples: The design is wasteful in an obvious and expensive way. | Wasteful habits survive while energy is cheap.

Pattern: metered + N (supply, heating)
Examples: Metered heating changed how the block behaved. | The supply is metered at the boundary.

Pattern: crank up + N hoặc crank + N + up; tách được
Examples: They cranked up the heating for one visitor. | The station cranked output up during the cold snap.

Pattern: switch on + N hoặc switch + N + on; tách được
Examples: They switched on the second boiler in January. | Nobody switches the immersion heater on in summer.

Pattern: wear out; wear + N + out; tách được
Examples: The pump wore out after nine winters. | They wore the bearings out in one season.

Pattern: pack up; không có tân ngữ
Examples: The boiler packed up on the coldest night. | Two generators packed up within a month.

Pattern: warm through + N hoặc warm + N + through; tách được
Examples: The house takes two hours to warm through. | They warm the room through before the baby is bathed.

Pattern: seal off + N hoặc seal + N + off; tách được
Examples: They sealed off the unused chimney. | The cellar was sealed off to stop the draught.

Pattern: trip out; không có tân ngữ
Examples: The circuit trips out whenever both heaters run. | The whole board tripped out in the storm.

Definition: trang bị, lắp đặt thiết bị
Pattern: fit out + N hoặc fit + N + out; tách được
Examples: The flat was fitted out with low-energy lighting throughout. | They fitted the loft out as a workshop.

Pattern: run off + N; không tách được
Examples: The lights run off a single battery. | The whole workshop runs off one panel in summer.

Term: burn the candle at both ends
Definition: làm việc quá sức, vắt kiệt sức lực
Pattern: burn the candle at both ends
Examples: He burned the candle at both ends for nine months. | Burning the candle at both ends caught up with her.

Definition: giữ gìn tổ ấm khi người thân vắng nhà
Pattern: keep the home fires burning
Examples: One wood burner kept the home fires burning that winter. | She kept the home fires burning on a prepayment meter.

Pattern: add fuel to the fire
Examples: The price rise added fuel to the fire. | Blaming the households added fuel to the fire.

Definition: tiết kiệm mà hoá tốn kém
Pattern: be + a false economy
Examples: Buying the cheapest boiler was a false economy. | Skipping the insulation is a false economy.

Pattern: be/put sth + out of action
Examples: The turbine was out of action for nine weeks. | One storm put the whole line out of action.

Definition: đi vào hoạt động ổn định
Pattern: be/get sth + up and running
Examples: The system was up and running by the evening. | They got the generator up and running in minutes.

Pattern: be + back to square one
Examples: The refusal put the scheme back to square one. | After the survey they were back to square one.

Pattern: do sth + under one's own steam
Examples: They insulated the house under their own steam. | The cooperative got going under its own steam.

Pattern: be + a stopgap measure
Examples: The subsidy was a stopgap measure that lasted nine years. | Keeping the old plant open is a stopgap measure.

Pattern: bite the bullet
Examples: They bit the bullet and replaced the whole system. | The council bit the bullet and borrowed.
